text:
Alex P: Ok team — Q3 pilot cutline check. Need to lock launch criteria for ACME pilot by EOD Friday. Main dependencies: HSM/KMS onboarding (security), runtime prewarm/quant config (runtime/eng), infra reservation for 2x A100 per tenant (infra), product acceptance tests and eval set (product).
Maria PD: Copy. We need final acceptance criteria from product: 95p latency < 300ms, sustained 2k qps on reserved capacity, and rollback path to smaller model. I'll post the eval set by tomorrow.
Devon (runtime): Runtime status: prewarm + prefix caching mostly ready, but quantized variant is unstable at batch-size=8. We either fix quant path or route to float-16 fallback.
Sam E: I can take a PR to add a safe fallback (float16 path) — ETA Tue. Will need infra slots to run perf/stress.
Lee (infra): @Sam we can carve two staging nodes in cluster-02 starting Wed. Prod reservation for pilot requires a PO/commit. How many hours/day for perf runs?
Sam E: Mostly daytime 8am-6pm, ~3 calendar days of heavy tests.
Tessa (security): For HSM onboarding we need a completed pen-test checklist + KMS policy doc. Onboarding is ~2 weeks after we have a service account and ACME's HSM IP allowlist. Who owns getting ACME's approvals?
Alex P: @Tessa I can coordinate with ACME legal to get the service account. @Maria can you gather ACME compliance contacts?
Maria PD: On it — I'll DM the contacts and put them in the portal.
Devon (runtime): Two quick asks: (1) infra guarantee node types (A100 80GB) for perf parity; (2) set a canary route: 5% traffic to pilot variant then ramp to 100% if no regressions.
Lee (infra): A100 80GB available for booking; need chargeback codes. Opening ticket INFRA-2345 to track. @Alex can you provide chargeback/PO?
Alex P: Will get PO queued. Decision point: if HSM not ready, fallback to cloud-KMS (hosted) for pilot as a temporary measure — requires product signoff and ACME agreement.
Maria PD: We can't accept hosted KMS for ACME — they require HSM. Fallback is a no-go for this customer. That makes security onboarding the critical path.
Tessa (security): We can fast-track HSM if ACME signs the DPA and provides the IP allowlist. Once we have that, estimate 3 business days to finalize onboarding steps.
Sam E: If security blocks production, I'd suggest a soft internal launch with synthetic traffic to validate runtime and perf while HSM completes. Keeps progress without exposing customer data.
Alex P: :thumbsup: Good mitigation. Owner matrix (quick): Product (Maria) — acceptance criteria + ACME contacts; Security (Tessa) — HSM checklist + onboarding; Infra (Lee) — prod reservation + staging nodes; Eng (Sam) — quant fallback PR + perf runs; Runtime (Devon) — canary routing + caching config.
Alex P: I'll summarize action items and deadlines: Maria - contact ACME compliance by Tue EOD; Tessa - HSM checklist by Wed COB; Lee - open INFRA ticket + reserve nodes by Wed; Sam - PR by Tue; Devon - canary routing plan by Thu. If any slippage, we shift pilot by 2 weeks. Agreed?
Maria PD: Agreed.
Lee (infra): Agreed.
Tessa (security): Agreed, prioritizing HSM.
deploy-bot: INFRA-2345 created by Lee — A100 reservation requested.
Alex P: Thanks all. I'll drop this into the roadmap doc and ping exec if we need to change the schedule.
